node_notes.boot: This step runs the firmware entry shim and calls app_start(). The call is in main/entry.c:4-7.
node_notes.start: This step logs the firmware-started message when app_start() runs. The ESP_LOGI call is in firmware/app/app.c:6-10.
node_notes.output: This step represents the ESP-IDF logging macro's output path. firmware/utils/logger/logger.h re-exports esp_log.h, and the application uses ESP_LOGI.
